result.topic_en: Calculations reducing a linear second-order ODE to a Riccati equation by the substitution u = e^{log u}, then transforming the Riccati equation with integrating factors e^{∫y dx} and changes of the independent variable; a side calculation on an arc-length-like element dx' and d log g'.
result.transcription:
$y\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+y^2 u=0$ [?]
$u=e^{\log u}$ $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}=e^{\log u}\left(v^2+\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)$
$v^2+\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+\frac14 y^2=0$
$\mu\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}+w\frac{\partial \mu}{\partial x}+\mu^2 w^2+\frac14 y^2=0$
$\frac{\partial \mu}{\partial x}=\pm\mu y$
$\mu=e^{\int y\partial x}$. $\mu\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}+\left(\mu w+\frac12 y\right)^2=0$,
$w+\frac{y}{2\mu}=v_1$ $\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial\, y e^{-\int y\partial x}}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v_1}{\partial x}$ $\qquad v+\frac{y}{2}=[-\mu-]v_1 e^{\int y\partial x}$
$\frac{1}{\mu}\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}+[-\mu-]\left(w+\frac{y}{2\mu}\right)^2=0$
$e^{-\int y\partial x}\frac{\partial v_1}{\partial x}-e^{-\int y\partial x}\frac{\partial\, y e^{-\int y\partial x}}{\partial x}+v_1^2=0$
$\frac14 y_1^2=-e^{-\int y\partial x}\frac{\partial\, y e^{-\int y\partial x}}{\partial x}=e^{-2\int y\partial x}\left(y^2-\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}\right)$
$\partial x_1=\int e^{\int y\partial x}\partial x$
$\partial x'=\partial x\sqrt{1+p^2+\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}+p\,\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}}$ [?]
$d\log g'=s'dx'=$ [-$2p\partial x+d\log\frac{\partial x'}{\partial x}$-]
$=2p\partial x+d\log\frac{\partial x'}{\partial x}+s\,dx$
$\frac{4}{y^2}+\frac{4}{v^2 y^2}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+\frac{1}{v^2}=0$
$s'=(2p+s)(1+p^2+\cdots)^{-\frac12}+\frac12(1+p^2+\cdots)^{-\frac32}\frac{\partial(1+p^2+\cdots)}{\partial x}$
$v'=\frac1v$
$\frac{y'^2}{4}=\frac{4}{y^2}$
$\partial x'=-\frac{y^2}{4}\partial x$
$v_p=-\frac{y}{2}+v_1 e^{\int y\partial x}$
$=-\frac{y}{2}+\frac{e^{\int y\partial x}}{v_1'}$
$\frac{y_1'^2}{4}=e^{2\int y\partial x}\frac{1}{y^2-\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}}$ $\qquad \frac{y_1'}{2}\partial x_1'=\frac{1}{\sqrt{y^2-\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}}}\cdot\left(-y^2+\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}\right)\partial x$
$\partial x_1'=y e^{-\int y\partial x}$ $\qquad y_1'\partial x_1'=[-2-]\sqrt{y^2-\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}}\,\partial x$
